data.summary: This 10‑week plan starts with the student’s weak units (Kinetics and Equilibrium) and interleaves them with other units, ensuring every unit appears at least once. Live classes are scheduled in the weeks they occur and are paired with matching topics. The final week is a mixed review and timed practice session.

weeks.focus: Review fundamentals of moles and atomic structure
tasks: Do 15 practice problems on mole calculations, then check answers with the scoring guide
Read the chapter on atomic structure and write a 200‑word summary of key concepts

weeks.focus: Deep dive into kinetics with live class
tasks: Watch live class 9000 and take detailed notes
Do 10 free‑response questions on rate laws, then mark them against the scoring guide
Solve 5 problems on reaction rates using stoichiometry
Create flashcards for ionic solid structures
Solve 8 stoichiometry problems involving gas laws
Do a timed practice set on the ideal gas law
Attend live class 9001 and summarize key points
Do 12 practice problems on equilibrium constants and reaction quotients
Write a short explanation of Le Chatelier’s principle
Draw energy diagrams for 5 reactions
Calculate ΔH for 5 endothermic/exothermic processes
Do 10 practice problems on kinetic molecular theory
Calculate pH for 5 weak acid solutions
Solve 5 buffer capacity problems
Do a mixed practice set on equilibrium constants for acid–base reactions
Attend live class 9002 and note key concepts
Do 10 problems on galvanic cells and Gibbs free energy
Review pOH calculations for strong bases

weeks.focus: Integrated review of kinetics and equilibrium
tasks: Solve 8 elementary reaction rate problems
Do 8 practice problems on reaction direction and equilibrium shifts
Create a concept map linking kinetics to equilibrium
Do a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all units
Review incorrect answers and rewrite explanations
Summarize key formulas for each unit in a single sheet

weeks.focus: Final timed practice and exam strategy
tasks: Take a full-length AP Chemistry practice exam under timed conditions
Analyze performance and identify remaining weak spots
Create a one‑page cheat sheet of essential equations and concepts

data.final_week_advice: In the last week, focus on timed practice and quick recall of formulas. Review any remaining weak areas, but prioritize overall confidence and test‑taking strategies.
